question: Where is the equals button on the calculator?
reply:
The equals button on the calculator is located at the bottom right corner of the calculator window. You can find it by looking at the calculator and moving down to the last row of buttons, and then moving to the right until you see the equals sign.

question: How do I close without saving?
reply:
To close without saving, you can click on the Don't Save button in the dialog box. This will discard any changes made to the file and close the window.
[POINT:557,539:Don't Save]

question: Which button keeps my changes?
reply:

question: How do I go back to editing?
reply:
